simulation.note: game.update(dt) with a fixed dt, game.netSync() at netSyncTps, like survev's game process

randomModes.seeded: Math.random = mulberry32(seed); used for game creation (map generation) and natural-randomness runs
randomModes.centered: Math.random() = 0.5: zero spread deviation, zero shotgun pellet jitter, bullet distAdj index 8 (0 m), headshot roll fails
randomModes.low: Math.random() = 0: deviation -spread/2, pellet jitter -jitter, bullet distAdj index 0 (-1 m)
randomModes.high: Math.random() = 1 - 2^-53: deviation +spread/2, pellet jitter +jitter, bullet distAdj index 16 (+1 m)

verification.check: ids whose survev def differs from ours after the patch

params.random: centered (zero deviation and jitter), headshots never; bullet flights also in low/high modes
params.shooter: stationary test player with debug.godMode, facing +x on the empty oracle map
params.trigger: auto/burst: shootHold every tick; single: shootHold + shootStart every tick (spam clicking)
params.timeConvention: times are tick differences * dt; an input sent before tick N+1 and a shot fired during tick M are (M - N) * dt apart

notes: fire cooldowns are decremented by dt every tick and compared with <= 0 (auto) or < 0 (single, burst); with a fixed dt the float residue of repeated subtraction can add one extra tick (e.g. ak47 fireDelay 0.1 -> 0.11 s at 100 Hz)
reload.actions times are relative to the last shot of the magazine; a new reload of a single-load gun starts on the tick after the previous one completes (Player.reloadAgain)
switch delays: freeSwitch uses GameConfig.player.baseSwitchDelay when freeSwitchTimer < 0; rapidSwitch uses the gun's switchDelay (WeaponManager.setCurWeapIndex)
bullet distance = bulletDef.distance * (1 + variance) + distAdj, distAdj in [-1, 1] m (0 in centered mode; shotgun bullets with noDistAdj always 0)
bugle has no reload action: survev refills bugle_ammo on a role/perk timer, not via reload
